title: Octowright runs on the MCP 2.0 Python SDK
body: Octowright now runs on the MCP 2.0 Python SDK. Installs had started breaking outright — the SDK's 2.0 release removed the module octowright imported, and the dependency had no upper bound, so a fresh install pulled a version the daemon could not start on. If you pin `mcp` yourself, you now need 2.0 or newer.

title: The long-call keepalive survived the SDK upgrade
body: The keepalive that stops long tool calls from looking like a dropped connection survived the upgrade — MCP 2.0 changed how request metadata reaches a tool, in a way that would have switched the keepalive (and duplicate-call protection) off silently rather than loudly.
